@graph.comment: Caches the serialized output of the out-converter, per content-type, keyed by resource version, so repeat cross-type reads (e.g. Turtle on disk read as application/ld+json) skip both the parse and the serialize. It wraps the default UiEnabledConverter. To use it, point the RepresentationConvertingStore's `options_outConverter` at urn:solid-server:default:CachedOutConverter (override urn:solid-server:default:ResourceStore_Converting).
